UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile, settings, career statistics, and resumable Classic Endless board state.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

highestCombo.description: Highest consecutive line-clear combo multiplier achieved.

totalLinesCleared.description: Total rows and columns cleared across all games.

dailyStreak.description: Current consecutive Daily Challenge completion streak.

lastDailyDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent completed Daily Challenge.

soundEnabled.description: Whether synthesized PCM sound effects are enabled.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether haptic vibration feedback is enabled.

showLinePreview.description: Whether prospective line-clear highlights are shown during drag.

savedClassicBoard.description: Flattened 64-cell 8x8 board state (0 = empty, 1..7 = jewel color ID) for resuming Classic Endless.

savedClassicScore.description: Score of the saved Classic Endless session.

savedClassicCombo.description: Active combo streak of the saved Classic Endless session.

savedClassicTray.description: Up to 3 encoded tray piece descriptors (shapeId:colorId or empty) for the saved Classic session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public global leaderboard ranking entry per player without PII.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this leaderboard entry.

bestScore.description: Player best score on the global leaderboard.

isPublic.description: Marks leaderboard entry as visible on the global leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last leaderboard update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private game profile, settings, stats, and resumable Classic board state.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard scores readable by authenticated players and writable only by the owning player.
